short_title_en: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
short_title_hi: लैंगिक अपराधों से बालकों का संरक्षण (पॉक्सो) अधिनियम, 2012

sections.section_title: Short title and commencement of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
sections.section_body:
(1) This Act may be called the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012.
(2) It extends to the whole of India.
(3) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.

In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires, terms and expressions used herein shall have the meanings respectively assigned to them in the General Clauses Act, 1897 and relevant statutory enactments.
